info.name: Returns a single Replicate model with its input parameter schema.

params.name: modelOwner
params.description: The owner of the hosted model.

items.docs:
When supportsImageReference is true the model accepts a reference image that the
 platform auto-fills with a prompt's attached media; that input is excluded from the returned
 parameters and must not be configured by the customer.

info.name: Searches Replicate models by free-text term.

params.name: search
params.description: The free-text term to search models by.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor continuing a previous search; omit for the first page.

items.docs:
Results are cursor-paginated: pass the returned nextCursor back as cursor to
 fetch the next page.
